answer.summary: A narrow research question is proposed to investigate explicit temporal dependencies in memory state transitions under controlled perturbations in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 without relying on assumed decay or persistence mechanisms.
answer.content: Investigate whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 reports any explicitly defined temporal dependencies between input sequences and subsequent memory state transitions under known perturbations; if so, identify the shortest observed sequence or time interval that correlates with a detectable shift in memory state as a potential indicator of structured temporal memory dynamics.
